title: Formal Jacobian minors detect a nondegenerate binary quadratic hypersurface
statement: Let $F$ be a field, $n\ge2$, $T=F[[t_1,\ldots,t_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], $\mathfrak n=(t_1,\ldots,t_n)$, and $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_s)\subseteq\mathfrak n$. Set $R=T/I$ with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m=\mathfrak n/I$. Let $J\subseteq R$ be the ideal generated by the images of the $(n-1)\times(n-1)$ minors [def-weil-matrix, def-weil-pbc-matrix-determinant] of the matrix $(\partial f_j/\partial t_i)$, where formal differentiation is termwise differentiation of power series. Then the following are equivalent: (a) $\operatorname{depth}(R)=1$ [def-weil-pbc-depth] and $J=\mathfrak m$; (b) $R$ is isomorphic as a complete local $F$-algebra to $F[[u,v]]/(au^2+buv+cv^2)$ for some $a,b,c\in F$ with $b^2-4ac\ne0$. (c) $R$ is isomorphic as a ring (not necessarily $F$-linearly) to $F[[u,v]]/(au^2+buv+cv^2)$ for some $a,b,c\in F$ with $b^2-4ac\ne0$. The discriminant condition means that the linear map with matrix $\left(\begin{smallmatrix}2a&b\\ b&2c\end{smallmatrix}\right)$ is invertible, including in characteristic $2$.

source.place: Tags 0C4C (lemma-fitting-ideal), equivalence (1) and (3), and 0C49 (lemma-nodal-algebraic), conditions (1) and (3); condition (1) of 0C49 (reduced, embedding dimension 2, a nondegenerate quadric in Sym^2 of the cotangent space vanishing in m^2/m^3) is invariant under ring isomorphisms, the residue-field isomorphism transporting the quadric, which gives (c) to (b). n>=2 avoids the negative-minor convention.
